Summary

CBACT01C is a batch COBOL program in the CardDemo application that reads account records sequentially from an indexed account file and writes the data into multiple output files. For each account record read, it populates and writes a formatted account record to a sequential output file, an array-based record to an array file, and two variable-length records to a variable-length record file. The program also performs date formatting by calling an external assembler routine (COBDATFT) and applies specific business rules such as defaulting the current cycle debit to 2525.00 when it is zero.
- **Execution Environment**: Batch - **Database Access**: VSAM (Indexed), Sequential Files - **MQ Calls**: No - **Module Type**: Main/Driver Program
### Key Functionalities: 1: Open Account File - Open the indexed account master file in sequential read mode to begin processing all account records 2: Open Output Account File - Open the sequential output file where processed account records will be written 3: Open Array Output File - Open the sequential array file where account balance array records will be written 4: Open Variable-Length Record File - Open the sequential variable-length record file where two types of account records will be written 5: Read Next Account Record - Sequentially read the next account record from the indexed account master file and detect end-of-file condition 6: Display Account Record Details - Display all fields of the current account record including account ID, active status, current balance, credit limit, cash credit limit, open date, expiration date, reissue date, current cycle credit, current cycle debit, and group ID 7: Format Account Reissue Date - Call external date formatting routine (COBDATFT) to convert the account reissue date into the required output format 8: Apply Default Cycle Debit Value - If the account current cycle debit amount is zero, assign a default value of 2525.00 to the output record 9: Populate Output Account Record - Map all account fields (ID, active status, current balance, credit limit, cash credit limit, open date, expiration date, formatted reissue date, current cycle credit, current cycle debit, group ID) to the output account record structure 10: Write Output Account Record - Write the fully populated account record to the sequential output file 11: Populate Account Balance Array Record - Build an array record for the account containing the account ID and five balance slots: slot 1 with current balance and fixed debit of 1005.00, slot 2 with current balance and fixed debit of 1525.00, slot 3 with fixed balance of -1025.00 and fixed debit of -2500.00 12: Write Account Balance Array Record - Write the populated array record containing multiple balance entries to the array output file 13: Populate Short Variable-Length Record - Build a short account record (12 bytes) containing account ID and active status for writing to the variable-length record file 14: Populate Long Variable-Length Record - Build a long account record (39 bytes) containing account ID, current balance, credit limit, and reissue year for writing to the variable-length record file 15: Write Short Variable-Length Record - Write the 12-byte variable-length record containing account ID and active status to the variable-length record file 16: Write Long Variable-Length Record - Write the 39-byte variable-length record containing account ID, current balance, credit limit, and reissue year to the variable-length record file 17: Process All Accounts Loop - Repeatedly read and process each account record from the account master file until all records have been processed (end-of-file reached) 18: Close Account File - Close the account master file after all records have been processed

Datasource Information (4)

Datasource Name Type Usage
ACCTFILE-FILE INDEXED (VSAM KSDS) Input - Sequentially reads account records containing account ID, balance, credit limits, dates, and group information
OUT-FILE SEQUENTIAL Output - Writes formatted account records including account ID, active status, balances, credit limits, dates, and group ID
ARRY-FILE SEQUENTIAL Output - Writes array-based account records containing account ID and multiple sets of balance and debit cycle amounts
VBRC-FILE SEQUENTIAL Output - Writes two variable-length records per account: a short record with account ID and active status, and a longer record with account ID, balance, credit limit, and reissue year

Business Rules

Supporting Code

Open Account Master File for Reading-L_0000: ```cobol 0000-ACCTFILE-OPEN. MOVE 8 TO APPL-RESULT. OPEN INPUT ACCTFILE-FILE IF ACCTFILE-STATUS = '00' MOVE 0 TO APPL-RESULT ELSE MOVE 12 TO APPL-RESULT END-IF IF APPL-AOK CONTINUE ELSE DISPLAY 'ERROR OPENING ACCTFILE' MOVE ACCTFILE-STATUS TO IO-STATUS PERFORM 9910-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS PERFORM 9999-ABEND-PROGRAM END-IF ``` Open Output Account File for Writing-L_2000: ```cobol 2000-OUTFILE-OPEN. MOVE 8 TO APPL-RESULT. OPEN OUTPUT OUT-FILE IF OUTFILE-STATUS = '00' MOVE 0 TO APPL-RESULT ELSE MOVE 12 TO APPL-RESULT END-IF IF APPL-AOK CONTINUE ELSE DISPLAY 'ERROR OPENING OUTFILE' OUTFILE-STATUS MOVE OUTFILE-STATUS TO IO-STATUS PERFORM 9910-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS PERFORM 9999-ABEND-PROGRAM END-IF ``` Open Array Output File for Writing-L_3000: ```cobol 3000-ARRFILE-OPEN. MOVE 8 TO APPL-RESULT. OPEN OUTPUT ARRY-FILE IF ARRYFILE-STATUS = '00' MOVE 0 TO APPL-RESULT ELSE MOVE 12 TO APPL-RESULT END-IF IF APPL-AOK CONTINUE ELSE DISPLAY 'ERROR OPENING ARRAYFILE' ARRYFILE-STATUS MOVE ARRYFILE-STATUS TO IO-STATUS PERFORM 9910-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS PERFORM 9999-ABEND-PROGRAM END-IF ``` Open Variable-Length Record File for Writing-L_4000: ```cobol 4000-VBRFILE-OPEN. MOVE 8 TO APPL-RESULT. OPEN OUTPUT VBRC-FILE IF VBRCFILE-STATUS = '00' MOVE 0 TO APPL-RESULT ELSE MOVE 12 TO APPL-RESULT END-IF IF APPL-AOK CONTINUE ELSE DISPLAY 'ERROR OPENING VBRC FILE' VBRCFILE-STATUS MOVE VBRCFILE-STATUS TO IO-STATUS PERFORM 9910-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS PERFORM 9999-ABEND-PROGRAM END-IF ``` Read Next Account Record from Account Master File-L_1000: ```cobol 1000-ACCTFILE-GET-NEXT. READ ACCTFILE-FILE INTO ACCOUNT-RECORD. IF ACCTFILE-STATUS = '00' MOVE 0 TO APPL-RESULT ELSE IF ACCTFILE-STATUS = '10' MOVE 16 TO APPL-RESULT ELSE MOVE 12 TO APPL-RESULT END-IF END-IF IF APPL-AOK CONTINUE ELSE IF APPL-EOF MOVE 'Y' TO END-OF-FILE ELSE DISPLAY 'ERROR READING ACCOUNT FILE' MOVE ACCTFILE-STATUS TO IO-STATUS PERFORM 9910-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS PERFORM 9999-ABEND-PROGRAM END-IF END-IF ``` Display Account Record Details to Console-L_1100: ```cobol 1100-DISPLAY-ACCT-RECORD. DISPLAY 'ACCT-ID :' ACCT-ID DISPLAY 'ACCT-ACTIVE-STATUS :' ACCT-ACTIVE-STATUS DISPLAY 'ACCT-CURR-BAL :' ACCT-CURR-BAL DISPLAY 'ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT :' ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT DISPLAY 'ACCT-CASH-CREDIT-LIMIT :' ACCT-CASH-CREDIT-LIMIT DISPLAY 'ACCT-OPEN-DATE :' ACCT-OPEN-DATE DISPLAY 'ACCT-EXPIRAION-DATE :' ACCT-EXPIRAION-DATE DISPLAY 'ACCT-REISSUE-DATE :' ACCT-REISSUE-DATE DISPLAY 'ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT :' ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT DISPLAY 'ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT :' ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT DISPLAY 'ACCT-GROUP-ID :' ACCT-GROUP-ID DISPLAY '-------------------------------------------------' ``` Convert Account Reissue Date Format-L_1300: ```cobol MOVE ACCT-REISSUE-DATE TO CODATECN-INP-DATE WS-REISSUE-DATE. MOVE '2' TO CODATECN-TYPE. MOVE '2' TO CODATECN-OUTTYPE. CALL 'COBDATFT' USING CODATECN-REC. MOVE CODATECN-0UT-DATE TO OUT-ACCT-REISSUE-DATE. ``` Apply Default Current Cycle Debit When Zero-L_1300: ```cobol IF ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT EQUAL TO ZERO MOVE 2525.00 TO OUT-ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT END-IF. ``` Populate Output Account Record Fields-L_1300: ```cobol 1300-POPUL-ACCT-RECORD. MOVE ACCT-ID TO OUT-ACCT-ID. MOVE ACCT-ACTIVE-STATUS TO OUT-ACCT-ACTIVE-STATUS. MOVE ACCT-CURR-BAL TO OUT-ACCT-CURR-BAL. MOVE ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT TO OUT-ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT. MOVE ACCT-CASH-CREDIT-LIMIT TO OUT-ACCT-CASH-CREDIT-LIMIT MOVE ACCT-OPEN-DATE TO OUT-ACCT-OPEN-DATE. MOVE ACCT-EXPIRAION-DATE TO OUT-ACCT-EXPIRAION-DATE. MOVE ACCT-REISSUE-DATE TO CODATECN-INP-DATE WS-REISSUE-DATE. MOVE '2' TO CODATECN-TYPE. MOVE '2' TO CODATECN-OUTTYPE. CALL 'COBDATFT' USING CODATECN-REC. MOVE CODATECN-0UT-DATE TO OUT-ACCT-REISSUE-DATE. MOVE ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT TO OUT-ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT. IF ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT EQUAL TO ZERO MOVE 2525.00 TO OUT-ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT END-IF. MOVE ACCT-GROUP-ID TO OUT-ACCT-GROUP-ID. ``` Write Transformed Account Record to Output File-L_1350: ```cobol 1350-WRITE-ACCT-RECORD. WRITE OUT-ACCT-REC. IF OUTFILE-STATUS NOT = '00' AND OUTFILE-STATUS NOT = '10' DISPLAY 'ACCOUNT FILE WRITE STATUS IS:' OUTFILE-STATUS MOVE OUTFILE-STATUS TO IO-STATUS PERFORM 9910-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS PERFORM 9999-ABEND-PROGRAM END-IF. ``` Populate Account Balance Array Record with Three Fixed Slots-L_1400: ```cobol 1400-POPUL-ARRAY-RECORD. MOVE ACCT-ID TO ARR-ACCT-ID. MOVE ACCT-CURR-BAL TO ARR-ACCT-CURR-BAL(1). MOVE 1005.00 TO ARR-ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT(1). MOVE ACCT-CURR-BAL TO ARR-ACCT-CURR-BAL(2). MOVE 1525.00 TO ARR-ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT(2). MOVE -1025.00 TO ARR-ACCT-CURR-BAL(3). MOVE -2500.00 TO ARR-ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT(3). ``` Write Account Balance Array Record to Array File-L_1450: ```cobol 1450-WRITE-ARRY-RECORD. WRITE ARR-ARRAY-REC. IF ARRYFILE-STATUS NOT = '00' AND ARRYFILE-STATUS NOT = '10' DISPLAY 'ACCOUNT FILE WRITE STATUS IS:' ARRYFILE-STATUS MOVE ARRYFILE-STATUS TO IO-STATUS PERFORM 9910-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS PERFORM 9999-ABEND-PROGRAM END-IF. ``` Populate Short Variable-Length Record with Account Identity Data-L_1500: ```cobol MOVE ACCT-ID TO VB1-ACCT-ID MOVE ACCT-ACTIVE-STATUS TO VB1-ACCT-ACTIVE-STATUS. ``` Populate Long Variable-Length Record with Account Financial Data-L_1500: ```cobol MOVE ACCT-ID TO VB2-ACCT-ID. MOVE ACCT-CURR-BAL TO VB2-ACCT-CURR-BAL. MOVE ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT TO VB2-ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT. MOVE WS-ACCT-REISSUE-YYYY TO VB2-ACCT-REISSUE-YYYY. DISPLAY 'VBRC-REC1:' VBRC-REC1. DISPLAY 'VBRC-REC2:' VBRC-REC2. ``` Write Short Variable-Length Record to Variable-Length File-L_1550: ```cobol 1550-WRITE-VB1-RECORD. MOVE 12 TO WS-RECD-LEN. MOVE VBRC-REC1 TO VBR-REC(1:WS-RECD-LEN). WRITE VBR-REC. IF VBRCFILE-STATUS NOT = '00' AND VBRCFILE-STATUS NOT = '10' DISPLAY 'ACCOUNT FILE WRITE STATUS IS:' VBRCFILE-STATUS MOVE VBRCFILE-STATUS TO IO-STATUS PERFORM 9910-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS PERFORM 9999-ABEND-PROGRAM END-IF. ``` Write Long Variable-Length Record to Variable-Length File-L_1575: ```cobol 1575-WRITE-VB2-RECORD. MOVE 39 TO WS-RECD-LEN. MOVE VBRC-REC2 TO VBR-REC(1:WS-RECD-LEN). WRITE VBR-REC. IF VBRCFILE-STATUS NOT = '00' AND VBRCFILE-STATUS NOT = '10' DISPLAY 'ACCOUNT FILE WRITE STATUS IS:' VBRCFILE-STATUS MOVE VBRCFILE-STATUS TO IO-STATUS PERFORM 9910-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS PERFORM 9999-ABEND-PROGRAM END-IF. ``` Control Account Record Processing Loop Until End of File-L_MAIN: ```cobol PERFORM UNTIL END-OF-FILE = 'Y' IF END-OF-FILE = 'N' PERFORM 1000-ACCTFILE-GET-NEXT IF END-OF-FILE = 'N' DISPLAY ACCOUNT-RECORD END-IF END-IF END-PERFORM. ``` Close Account Master File After All Records Processed-L_9000: ```cobol 9000-ACCTFILE-CLOSE. ADD 8 TO ZERO GIVING APPL-RESULT. CLOSE ACCTFILE-FILE IF ACCTFILE-STATUS = '00' SUBTRACT APPL-RESULT FROM APPL-RESULT ELSE ADD 12 TO ZERO GIVING APPL-RESULT END-IF IF APPL-AOK CONTINUE ELSE DISPLAY 'ERROR CLOSING ACCOUNT FILE' MOVE ACCTFILE-STATUS TO IO-STATUS PERFORM 9910-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS PERFORM 9999-ABEND-PROGRAM END-IF ```

Read Account Records Until All Accounts Are Processed-L1: ```cobol PERFORM UNTIL END-OF-FILE = 'Y' IF END-OF-FILE = 'N' PERFORM 1000-ACCTFILE-GET-NEXT IF END-OF-FILE = 'N' DISPLAY ACCOUNT-RECORD END-IF END-IF END-PERFORM. ``` Read Account Records Until All Accounts Are Processed-L2: ```cobol READ ACCTFILE-FILE INTO ACCOUNT-RECORD. IF ACCTFILE-STATUS = '00' MOVE 0 TO APPL-RESULT ... ELSE IF ACCTFILE-STATUS = '10' MOVE 16 TO APPL-RESULT ELSE MOVE 12 TO APPL-RESULT END-IF END-IF IF APPL-AOK CONTINUE ELSE IF APPL-EOF MOVE 'Y' TO END-OF-FILE END-IF END-IF ``` Display Account Record Details on Console-L1: ```cobol 1100-DISPLAY-ACCT-RECORD. DISPLAY 'ACCT-ID :' ACCT-ID DISPLAY 'ACCT-ACTIVE-STATUS :' ACCT-ACTIVE-STATUS DISPLAY 'ACCT-CURR-BAL :' ACCT-CURR-BAL DISPLAY 'ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT :' ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT DISPLAY 'ACCT-CASH-CREDIT-LIMIT :' ACCT-CASH-CREDIT-LIMIT DISPLAY 'ACCT-OPEN-DATE :' ACCT-OPEN-DATE DISPLAY 'ACCT-EXPIRAION-DATE :' ACCT-EXPIRAION-DATE DISPLAY 'ACCT-REISSUE-DATE :' ACCT-REISSUE-DATE DISPLAY 'ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT :' ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT DISPLAY 'ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT :' ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT DISPLAY 'ACCT-GROUP-ID :' ACCT-GROUP-ID DISPLAY '-------------------------------------------------' ``` Convert Account Reissue Date Format-L1: ```cobol MOVE ACCT-REISSUE-DATE TO CODATECN-INP-DATE WS-REISSUE-DATE. MOVE '2' TO CODATECN-TYPE. MOVE '2' TO CODATECN-OUTTYPE. CALL 'COBDATFT' USING CODATECN-REC. MOVE CODATECN-0UT-DATE TO OUT-ACCT-REISSUE-DATE. ``` Apply Default Current Cycle Debit When Zero-L1: ```cobol IF ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT EQUAL TO ZERO MOVE 2525.00 TO OUT-ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT END-IF. ``` Populate Output Account Record Fields-L1: ```cobol 1300-POPUL-ACCT-RECORD. MOVE ACCT-ID TO OUT-ACCT-ID. MOVE ACCT-ACTIVE-STATUS TO OUT-ACCT-ACTIVE-STATUS. MOVE ACCT-CURR-BAL TO OUT-ACCT-CURR-BAL. MOVE ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT TO OUT-ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT. MOVE ACCT-CASH-CREDIT-LIMIT TO OUT-ACCT-CASH-CREDIT-LIMIT MOVE ACCT-OPEN-DATE TO OUT-ACCT-OPEN-DATE. MOVE ACCT-EXPIRAION-DATE TO OUT-ACCT-EXPIRAION-DATE. MOVE ACCT-REISSUE-DATE TO CODATECN-INP-DATE WS-REISSUE-DATE. MOVE '2' TO CODATECN-TYPE. MOVE '2' TO CODATECN-OUTTYPE. CALL 'COBDATFT' USING CODATECN-REC. MOVE CODATECN-0UT-DATE TO OUT-ACCT-REISSUE-DATE. MOVE ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT TO OUT-ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT. IF ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT EQUAL TO ZERO MOVE 2525.00 TO OUT-ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT END-IF. MOVE ACCT-GROUP-ID TO OUT-ACCT-GROUP-ID. ``` Write Populated Record to Output Account File-L1: ```cobol 1350-WRITE-ACCT-RECORD. WRITE OUT-ACCT-REC. ``` Populate Account Balance Array Record with Three Fixed Slots-L1: ```cobol 1400-POPUL-ARRAY-RECORD. MOVE ACCT-ID TO ARR-ACCT-ID. MOVE ACCT-CURR-BAL TO ARR-ACCT-CURR-BAL(1). MOVE 1005.00 TO ARR-ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT(1). MOVE ACCT-CURR-BAL TO ARR-ACCT-CURR-BAL(2). MOVE 1525.00 TO ARR-ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT(2). MOVE -1025.00 TO ARR-ACCT-CURR-BAL(3). MOVE -2500.00 TO ARR-ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT(3). ``` Write Account Balance Array Record to Array Output File-L1: ```cobol 1450-WRITE-ARRY-RECORD. WRITE ARR-ARRAY-REC. ``` Populate Short and Long Variable-Length Records-L1: ```cobol 1500-POPUL-VBRC-RECORD. MOVE ACCT-ID TO VB1-ACCT-ID VB2-ACCT-ID. MOVE ACCT-ACTIVE-STATUS TO VB1-ACCT-ACTIVE-STATUS. MOVE ACCT-CURR-BAL TO VB2-ACCT-CURR-BAL. MOVE ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT TO VB2-ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT. MOVE WS-ACCT-REISSUE-YYYY TO VB2-ACCT-REISSUE-YYYY. DISPLAY 'VBRC-REC1:' VBRC-REC1. DISPLAY 'VBRC-REC2:' VBRC-REC2. ``` Write Short Identity Record to Variable-Length File-L1: ```cobol 1550-WRITE-VB1-RECORD. MOVE 12 TO WS-RECD-LEN. MOVE VBRC-REC1 TO VBR-REC(1:WS-RECD-LEN). WRITE VBR-REC. ``` Write Long Financial Detail Record to Variable-Length File-L1: ```cobol 1575-WRITE-VB2-RECORD. MOVE 39 TO WS-RECD-LEN. MOVE VBRC-REC2 TO VBR-REC(1:WS-RECD-LEN). WRITE VBR-REC. ```

18: Close Account File

Business Rules

Supporting Code

Close Account Master File-L1: ```cobol CLOSE ACCTFILE-FILE ``` Validate Successful Closure of Account Master File-L2: ```cobol IF ACCTFILE-STATUS = '00' SUBTRACT APPL-RESULT FROM APPL-RESULT ELSE ADD 12 TO ZERO GIVING APPL-RESULT END-IF IF APPL-AOK CONTINUE ELSE DISPLAY 'ERROR CLOSING ACCOUNT FILE' MOVE ACCTFILE-STATUS TO IO-STATUS PERFORM 9910-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS PERFORM 9999-ABEND-PROGRAM END-IF ``` Confirm All Account Records Have Been Processed-L3: ```cobol PERFORM 9000-ACCTFILE-CLOSE. DISPLAY 'END OF EXECUTION OF PROGRAM CBACT01C'. GOBACK. ```
